workflows.title: Chats
workflows.line: Write, send, get a reply, react.

states.alt: lime's chat list: the Robotics regional group, then Talia Brooks, Mrs Lindgren, Adaeze Nwosu, Kofi Mensah and the Staff room, with photos, previews and unread counts

hs.label: Open the chat with Talia Brooks

states.alt: A chat with Talia Brooks: her exit ticket worked on third period, you asked what the question was, and she explains what half of the class wrote
The message field holds: That's the whole trick. Want my lab sheet for tomorrow?
Your message, That's the whole trick. Want my lab sheet for tomorrow?, has just gone
Talia Brooks answers: YES. I'll trade you my poem-of-the-week list

hs.label: Press and hold her message to react

states.alt: The reaction bar above her message: thumbs up, heart, laughing, surprised, sad, praying hands and a plus for more
A heart now sits on Talia Brooks's message

workflows.title: Groups

states.alt: The Robotics regional group: Walt, Danny and Talia plan Saturday's bus, permission slips and batteries, and a thumbs up with a 3 sits on Talia's message
The Robotics regional group's details: a workbench photo as the cover, four members, You (the owner), Walt Brennan, Danny Cruz and Talia Brooks, with tabs for Members, Media, Files and Links

workflows.title: Calls
workflows.line: Voice and video, and keep chatting while you talk.

states.alt: A video call with Maya, Walt, Mrs Lindgren and Danny: their photos fill the tiles, Walt is speaking and his tile is outlined; the controls are at the bottom
The call minimised over the Robotics regional chat: a small bar with Maya, Walt and the others, Video, 4 people, 1:33, a microphone and the end button, above the message field

workflows.title: Offline
workflows.line: No signal? Nearby phones pass your message along.

states.alt: No Wi-Fi, no service: the message waits for a phone nearby ("Waiting for a phone nearby"): Running late, start the warm-up without me
Still no Wi-Fi and no service: the message was passed to a nearby phone ("Passed to a nearby phone")
Back online: the message has gone ("Sent")
